scripts.// SERVE FRONTEND COMMAND //: Preconfigured cloud targets: local, cloud-test, dev2, dev3, stage, qa, regress, and meta. Use either preconfigured target or enter custom instance url
scripts.serve-frontend: export CLOUD_TARGET=$(npm run getCloudTarget | tail -n1) && npm run serve:cloud
scripts.// SERVE WEBADMIN COMMAND //: Preconfigured webadmin targets: local, demo, nuke, sofia, webpi, amir1, amir2, and brova. Use either preconfigured target or follow prompts to enter custom webadmin and cloud urls
scripts.serve-webadmin: export WEBADMIN_TARGET=$(npm run getWebadminTarget | tail -n1) && [[ $WEBADMIN_TARGET =~ ^http ]] && export CLOUD_TARGET=$(npm run getCloudTarget | tail -n1); npm run serve:webadmin
scripts.// SERVE AUTHORIZATION COMMAND //: Preconfigured auth targets: local, cloud-test, dev2, dev3, stage, qa, regress, and meta. Use either preconfigured target or enter custom instance url
scripts.serve-auth: export CLOUD_TARGET=$(npm run getCloudTarget | tail -n1) && npm run serve:auth
scripts.// SERVE SETUP WIZARD COMMAND //: Preconfigured webadmin targets: local. Use either preconfigured target or follow prompts to enter custom webadmin and cloud urls
scripts.serve-setup-wizard: export WEBADMIN_TARGET=$(npm run getWebadminTarget | tail -n1) && [[ $WEBADMIN_TARGET =~ ^http ]] && export CLOUD_TARGET=$(npm run getCloudTarget | tail -n1); npm run serve:setup-wizard
scripts.getCloudTarget: read -p 'Enter target cloud instance name or url: ' target && echo $target
scripts.getWebadminTarget: read -p 'Enter webadmin target name or url: ' target && echo $target
scripts.serve:cloud: npm run setVarSkin && npm run update-lang-files && nx run front-end:serve:$CLOUD_TARGET --proxy-config proxy.conf.front_end.js
scripts.serve:webadmin: npm run update-lang-files && nx run webadmin:serve:development --proxy-config proxy.conf.webadmin.js
scripts.serve:auth: npm run setVarSkin && npm run update-lang-files && nx run authorization:serve:development --proxy-config proxy.conf.auth.js
scripts.serve:setup-wizard: npm run setVarSkin && npm run update-lang-files && nx run setup-wizard:serve:development --proxy-config proxy.conf.setup-wizard.js
scripts.build: npm run cleardist && npm run lang && nx run-many --target=build --projects=front-end,authorization --configuration=production
scripts.build-webadmin: npm run cleardist && npm run lang && npx nx run-many --target=build --projects=webadmin,setup-wizard --configuration=production
scripts.ci:open: npm explore nx-open-web -- npm run ci:check && npm explore nx-open-web-candidate -- npm run ci:check
scripts.build:ci: npm run setSkin && npx nx run-many --target=build --configuration=production --all --exclude=unconverted
scripts.update-lang-files: node checkIfLangNeedsUpdate.mjs && npm run handle:lang || echo 'Lang already up to date'
scripts.lang-ci-check: cp ./common/language/language_i18n.json ./common/language/i18n_copy.json; cp ./common/language/language_compiled.json ./common/language/compiled_copy.json; npm run update-lang-files; cmp_i18n=$(cmp ./common/language/language_i18n.json ./common/language/i18n_copy.json); cmp_compiled=$(cmp ./common/language/language_compiled.json ./common/language/compiled_copy.json); if [ ! -z "$cmp_i18n" ] || [ ! -z "$cmp_static_types" ] || [ ! -z "$cmp_compiled" ]; then exit 1; fi
scripts.lang: node checkIfLangNeedsUpdate.mjs && npm run handle:lang || echo 'Lang already up to date'
scripts.handle:lang: npm run update-lang && npm run fill-lang && npm run compile-lang && npm run test-lang && node checkIfLangNeedsUpdate.mjs update
scripts.// HELPER COMMANDS //: Helper scripts used by other scripts
scripts.build-open-libs: npm install nx-open-web && npm install nx-open-web-candidate && npm explore nx-open-web -- npm install && npm explore nx-open-web -- npm run build && npm explore nx-open-web-candidate -- npm install && npm explore nx-open-web-candidate -- npm run build
scripts.bundle-report: npm run lang && nx run front-end:build:production  --stats-json && webpack-bundle-analyzer dist/stats.json -s gzip
scripts.bundle-report:auth: npm run lang && npx nx run authorization:build:production --stats-json && webpack-bundle-analyzer dist/authorization/stats.json -s gzip
scripts.cleardist: ([ -e ./dist ] && rm -rf ./dist) && echo 'Cleared dist folder' || echo 'No Dist to clear'
scripts.update-type-blacklist: export NX_TASK_TARGET_TARGET=lint; echo "module.exports = [];" > type-lint-error-count.js; echo "$(npx esprint check --workers=4)" > lint_out.txt; echo "$(node parse-lint-stdout.js)" > type-lint-error-count.js; rm lint_out.txt
scripts.// PROBABLY NOT USED COMMANDS //: Commands that are probably not used
scripts.auth:dev:ssr: npm run setVarSkin && npm run update-lang-files && npx nx run authorization:serve-ssr:$CLOUD_TARGET --proxy-config proxy.conf.auth.ssr.js
scripts.auth:build:ssr: npm run cleardist && npx nx run authorization:server:production
scripts.auth:prerender: npm run cleardist && npx nx run authorization:prerender
scripts.serve:setup-wizard:quick: npm run setVarSkin && nx run setup-wizard:serve:development --proxy-config proxy.conf.setup-wizard.js
scripts.esprint: export NX_TASK_TARGET_TARGET=lint; node esprintLimiter.js && eslint --ext .ts --fix || esprint check --fix --workers=$?
